name: Pinterest public widget API
tier_rationale: Pinterest, Inc., an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P116 FC9.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

widget_pins.title: Pinterest widget API (widgets.pinterest.com/v3/pidgets/users/{username}/pins/)

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

widget_pins.notes: Research C0271 + live check 2026-11-26: 'status': 'success' with data.user = FOUND; HTTP 404 code 30 'User not found.' = ABSENT; any other failure inside a 200 = error-in-200 (could not verify). Pin link domains are content (brand-abuse/fraud shops), only when relevant to the case.
